checkpoint: Two paid calls on Celo mainnet, triggered by an independent user's tests and bought by the production worker
whyThisIsDifferent: Every earlier paid call was initiated by hand. These were not: an independent builder, not the project owner, ran checks against their own website from the live site, the site answered the sandbox with HTTP 403, the runner recorded the outcome as blocked, the reports were prepared automatically, and the worker holding the sponsor key bought both without anyone asking it to.

trigger.testsRunBy: an independent user, on their own website
trigger.cause: the target answered the isolated browser with HTTP 403, which is bot protection declining an automated visitor rather than a fault in the site

purchases.reconcileNote: Deferred once. The first attempt at 11:11:36 found the transaction not yet final and rescheduled itself to 11:31:37 rather than claiming settlement, which is the intended separation of transaction inclusion from finality. The second purchase needed no deferral and reconciled at 11:12:06.

verifiedOnChain.method: eth_getTransactionReceipt against https://forno.celo.org, Transfer logs decoded
verifiedOnChain.senderNote: buy's facilitator, because USD₮ implements EIP-3009 and the payer signs off chain. No transaction of ours exists to carry an attribution tag.

whatHadToBeFixedFirst: The only code that initiated a purchase ran on the host, which has no sponsor key; the key was on Railway in a worker that only reconciled. Fixed in workers/main.ts (commit 8b23ab3).

The per-report cap had been raised to 25,000 on 2026-11-08 while the daily allowance stayed at 20,000, so sponsorBudgetFunded could never return true and every purchase was refused silently. The allowance was raised to 50,000 on 2026-11-10 with the user's explicit approval.
notClaimed: Both purchases are now reconciled against finalized chain state, each costing exactly its 10,000-unit quote, and the budget reads 20,000 settled with nothing reserved. What is still not claimed: this is one independent user, not adoption, and the explanations were delivered but their usefulness to that builder has not been measured or asked about.
